header.title: About the Community
header.subtitle: A student-led home for competition, growth, and campus pride.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide students with competitive gaming opportunities, foster teamwork and leadership skills, and represent DOrSU with excellence in collegiate esports competitions.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We strive for excellence in everything we do, from gameplay to fan engagement.

values.title: Teamwork
values.description: Success comes from collaboration, trust, and supporting each other.

values.title: Dedication
values.description: We are committed to continuous improvement and hard work.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We embrace new strategies and technologies to stay ahead of the competition.

achievements.title: Silver Finish for our raptors
achievements.description: They fought with precision, battled with pride, and proved their dominance in every match! Our DOrSU RAPTORS – CODM MP Girls Team soars high with a Silver Medal finish in the MASTS Esports 2025 Tournament!

achievements.title: The DOrSU Esports Reign Supreme
achievements.description: On October 27, 2025 our Call of Duty: Mobile Battle Royale team for emerging as the CHAMPIONS of the Philippine Collegiate Championship Open Cup - October COD:M Battle Royale Tournament.

achievements.title: Courtesy Call to Provincial Sports Director
achievements.description: The Davao Oriental State University (DORSU) Esports Community, together with representatives from Net Central Esports and VAIN Gamers, paid a courtesy call to Mr. Peter Paul Chiu, Provincial Sports Director, on September 26, 2025, to discuss the growing role of esports in the province.

achievements.title: GENERAL ASSEMBLY 2025
achievements.description: The DOrSU Esports Community successfully conducted its General Assembly on September 19, 2025, at 1:00 PM in the BITM Building. The assembly served as a venue for presenting plans, fostering collaboration, and strengthening the commitment of members toward the growth and development of the esports community at DOrSU.

achievements.title: Qualified to PCC Season 3 MLBB Regional Cup Tournament.
achievements.description: One of our own from DOrSU Esport Community is stepping into the Land of Dawn, repping us in the Philippine Collegiate Championship (PCC) Season 3 MLBB Regional Cup Tournament.

achievements.title: Panaghigalaay 2025
achievements.description: On August 22, 2025, the DOrSU Esports Community took part in Panaghigalaay 2025, a celebration that brought together students and organizations to strengthen bonds of unity friendship within the university.

achievements.title: DOrSU Esport Community Oath Taking
achievements.description: On August 15, 2025, the Davao Oriental State University (DOrSU) Esports Community officially held its oath-taking ceremony, signifying its formal recognition as a student organization within the Davao Oriental State University.
